reviews.review_msg: Kind and caring prof, lectures were useful and she explained concepts well. Exams were all based on lecture content.

Natalya is a kind and caring professor. Her explanations made the course material very easy to follow, and the tutorials were very helpful at bringing the course material into real life scenarios. The course consisted of 2 assignments, 1 midterm, and a final. Overall, if you review a little each day you will do fine in the course.

One of the best profs I've ever had in beedie, she's a great teacher, records her lectures, funny and accessible outside of class, is always willing to help, and an extremely kind and caring person! If you have an opportunity to take a class with her, don't miss out!!!! Her exams are fair and tutorials for this class are very engaging!

Take her for BUS488 if you have the chance!! She's funny and her lectures are engaging. Her grading criteria is super clear, marking is pretty fair and has fast response time. Midterm 20%, final 20%, 2 group presentations and a research paper. By far my favourite business professor at Beedie.
She is nice, but please be careful to listen to the lecture!
